blocks.text: About Minami Saki By Astoria Located in the heart of the Ortigas Business District, Minami Saki By Astoria offers an authentic Japanese dining experience shaped by its elegant interiors, carefully prepared Japanese cuisine, and attentive Astoria hospitality. Known for its refined Japanese fare, the restaurant brings together traditional flavors and a welcoming atmosphere for both everyday dining and special occasions. Beyond dining, Minami Saki By Astoria also offers function spaces suited for different occasions, whether for an intimate gathering, a business meeting, or a collaborative discussion.
